notes: All 7 web searches ran this time (the six required plus one on the Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act); none returned any statement by Fleischmann on superintelligence, extinction or existential risk, a pause or slowdown, a China AI agreement, or AI safety. The site-restricted search returned no fleischmann.house.gov pages, so the official site was checked directly in the earlier attempt: home page, page 1 of press releases (10 items, March to September 2026), page 1 of In the News (2025 items), the FY27 Energy and Water bill release of 15 May 2026 and the FY27 DOE budget hearing release of 16 April 2026 (re-opened this time; wording and date confirmed). The 15 May 2026 release mentions the Genesis Mission and AI only in press-office text, not in his words. The 16 April 2026 release also has him encouraged by the department's focus on research areas including artificial intelligence; not added as a separate statement. An In the News item of 30 April 2025 (op-ed 'The time to forge America's nuclear energy future is now') mentions advancements in AI in an energy context; not opened. Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538, Casar, 24 September 2026): search results name only Democratic cosponsors and none show Fleischmann; Congress.gov cosponsor list was not checked directly. No other House AI-risk letter signed by him was found. Older press release pages (64 pages in all) were not reviewed.
